title: Closed deal to team channel
disclaimer: Illustration · Sales Accelerator, n2N, Plank, and all people and records are made up

story.overview: When a rep marks a deal Closed Won in Sales Accelerator, an n2N workflow posts the win to the team's Plank channel within a second.
story.description: Sales teams want to celebrate wins the moment they happen, without anyone copying details from the CRM into chat. This film follows one deal through the whole automation: the change in the CRM, each step of the n2N workflow, the message it builds, and the post the team sees in Plank.
story.audience: Sales ops and RevOps teams building CRM automations
workflow: A rep changes the opportunity stage to Closed Won and saves it
n2N's Sales Accelerator trigger receives the updated record
An IF step checks that the stage is Closed Won
A Set step builds the message from the record's fields
The Plank step posts the message to #sales-wins

history.text: Q4 push starts Monday. Let's close strong! 🚀
